title: Hiccups
hook: George 喝果汁喝太快，打嗝停不下来，全家想尽办法帮他。

cells.a: They were all having breakfast together.
He drank his juice too quickly.
She said, “You can go out and play.”
She told him to throw the ball to her.
cells.cn: 她让 George 把球扔给她。

cells.a: George's hiccups were gone. Playing helped him.
cells.cn: George 不打嗝了，玩一玩就好了。

cells.a: She said, “Jump up and down three times on one leg.”

cells.q: What did Peppa say before she scared George?
cells.a: She said, “Remember, this is just pretend scaring.”
cells.cn: 她说：“记住，只是假装吓你一下。”

cells.a: She was only trying to stop his hiccups.
cells.cn: 她只是想帮他把打嗝止住。

cells.q: What did George say at the end?
cells.a: He said he can drink juice as quickly as he wants.
cells.cn: 他说他想喝多快就喝多快。
